title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: And yet Tom Wilson isn’t a fit President?
I’m pretty sure Colangelo pressured the Tigers into taking me off the beat
You mean he pressured the Freep? I didn’t know you were taken off the beat. Since when?
Yeah, my editors. Nothing is gonna come out publicly for a while but our Pistons writer took a buyout and I’m gonna cover them...hello Tom Wilson, i guess

Wow.  That’s interesting. Traditional journalism is getting hard to stomach. Nobody is allowed to show balls anymore. Tony Paul has had some good stuff but it’s mostly because he isn’t on a beat, either.
If you get a controversial story out before your removal from the beat comes out, the Freep will look like they caved bad
I know. I think it will look bad either way. The story won’t be done by then, I don’t think, but I could keep writing critical baseball stuff.
Maybe you can stay flexible like Tony. Seems like an asset to not be too close to every situation
I think it’s probably for the best. I could’ve started writing way more shit
Pistons is gonna be easier, it will give me more time for this story and they’ll probably still have me write about the Tigers
Yea probably true. Trouble with Pistons is that so many less people are paying attention. You’ll need to write other stuff for sake of career
